description: This file implements an in-memory vector store for educational text data, providing functionality for ingesting text, chunking it, and retrieving passages based on token overlap scoring. It includes internal helper functions for tokenizing and scoring, as well as public functions for ingesting and searching text data.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Splits input text into lowercase tokens, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: float _score(query_tokens: List[str], text_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Calculates a simple overlap-based score between query tokens and text tokens, normalized by the square root of text token count.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ingest_text(text: str, title: Optional[str], metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], namespace: str = "edu")
methods.description: Ingests input text into a simple in-memory structure, creating document and chunk entries with associated metadata.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] retrieve_passages(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, namespace: str = "edu")
methods.description: Retrieves top-k passages from the in-memory store based on token overlap scoring with an optional filter.

ctags.name: ingest_text
ctags.pattern: /^def ingest_text(text: str, title: Optional[str], metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], namespace: /
ctags.signature: (text: str, title: Optional[str], metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], namespace: str = "edu")

ctags.name: retrieve_passages
ctags.pattern: /^def retrieve_passages(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, name/
ctags.signature: (query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, namespace: str = "edu")
